specs.title: Preço em destaque
specs.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create a polished, ultra-realistic photographic social creative for Brazilian football-shirt curator ACHEI O MANTO, following the supplied Santos shirt and prior photographic direction.
Reference 1 is the product reference: white Santos shirt, pale icy-blue patterned V-neck, black Umbro chest mark on camera left, Santos S.F.C. crest with its gold crown and two stars on camera right, white fabric, no front sponsor. Preserve those features faithfully. Do not put the external Umbro/Santos campaign branding from the reference onto the creative.
Reference 2 is art direction only: charcoal studio, warm wooden hanger and chair, tactile textile closeups, gentle directional light. Any photos created must look like real product photography, not a render: gravity, folds, seams, fine weave, natural optical focus, no plastic sheen or illustrated look. Keep the shirt white and the pale blue collar unchanged.
Brand palette: charcoal #151A17, ivory #F4F1E8, acid lime #C5F246. Use clean expressive bold condensed typography, excellent Portuguese spelling, ample spacing, strong mobile readability. Every text line requested below must be exact. Preserve logos ON THE SHIRT; do not invent or redraw the store logo. Brand identification can use typography.
No discount percentage, no crossed-out old price, no urgency, no delivery or authenticity claim, no stars/reviews, no fake social media UI, no extra merchandise, no QR code or URL.

Asset: ONE finished vertical 4:5 poster, target 1440×1800 pixels. NOT a triptych or contact sheet.
Purpose: compelling product-price composition. The user explicitly chose an EXAMPLE price placeholder, not a real offer. Render exactly "R$ XX,XX"; never replace X with digits. The placeholder should still have the scale and typographic impact of a real price.
Scene/layout: a luxurious charcoal studio backdrop. Full Santos shirt photographed on a wooden hanger against a worn wood chair, centered-right occupying about 65% of image height, sleeves and hem fully visible. Smooth deep charcoal negative space at top and bottom left. Soft warm side light reveals stitching.
At top left, small ivory uppercase "ACHEI O MANTO" with a tiny lime rule.
Headline, upper left, bold condensed ivory, two punchy lines: "OLHA ESSE" and "ACHADO."
A broad clean acid-lime rectangular typographic price panel in the lower quarter, inset about 6% from the edges, just below the shirt rather than covering crest or collar. It should feel like considered sports editorial design, not a burst/star sticker.
Inside this panel, in dark charcoal: small label "ESSE MANTO POR" and extremely large "R$ XX,XX". Optional line breaks only before currency amount; keep the amount on ONE line. Strong hierarchy, the price is the key attention device.
Under the price panel, tiny but legible ivory "Preço a preencher" and "@acheiomanto" aligned on one baseline at opposite ends. This explicit label makes the mock price unambiguous.
Only the specified text. No button, no price guarantee, no made-up promotion.

Asset: ONE finished vertical 4:5 static ad concept for Instagram/Facebook Feed, target 1440×1800 pixels. NOT a screenshot, triptych, contact sheet, or ad-manager UI.
Objective: invite a viewer to discover the showcased shirt; focused conversion-style creative with a single action, without asserting a live destination or price.
Composition: upper 25% devoted to a bold compelling short headline, lower 65% dominated by an entire beautifully lit white Santos jersey on a wooden hanger, slightly off center right, with full sleeves/hem and pale blue V neck visible. Matte charcoal seamless studio background with subtle warm wood element, tightly framed and minimal. The garment is unmistakable at a glance. No extra photograph insets; no second shirt.
Exact text:
Top left small ivory brand name: "ACHEI O MANTO"
Large headline in two or three lines in upper area: "TEU PRÓXIMO" / "MANTO TÁ AQUI." The word "MANTO" is lime; remaining headline ivory. Use purposeful tight condensed typography, readable when small. Do not overlap the chest emblem with text.
At bottom left in legible medium ivory type: "CONFIRA OS DETALHES" followed by a clean right arrow. This is a typographic action line, NOT a fake rounded interface button.
Bottom right small "@acheiomanto".
No second CTA, no price, no "follow" request. Maintain generous 6–8% safety margin on all text. One clear product, one headline, one action.

Sequence: LEFT detailed shirt photo → CENTER entire shirt photo → RIGHT branded follow end card. Three full-height panels with clean coherent typography and brand colors.

Tiny bottom-left "@acheiomanto" and bottom-right "01/03", with a little lime rule above handle. No large headline on photo.
CENTER PANEL: the ENTIRE same white Santos shirt hanging on a wooden hanger in front of wooden chair against dark charcoal background. RIGHT PANEL, THE END CARD: mostly solid matte charcoal #151A17 with extremely subtle lower-right fabric shadow drawn from the same shirt; text is main subject, abundant negative space. No new symbols, no counterfeit store shield, no athletes.
At upper left, small tracked ivory "ACHEI O MANTO".
At around upper third, VERY large bold condensed ivory headline exactly:
"CURTIU"
"O MANTO?"
Below in medium ivory, exactly "Então cola na resenha."
Lower middle clear lime action as two lines: "SEGUE" and "@acheiomanto". The handle should be strong and prominent, without a simulated UI button.
Below, small ivory supporting brand voice as two lines: "Eu garimpo." / "Você escolhe."
Small "03/03" at bottom right. All text aligned to consistent 8% left margin. The end-card message needs to read easily even in this three-panel presentation.
No instruction to buy on this end card. No other text.
